0.0.n: ごはん can mean cooked rice or a meal; here it refers to dinner.

0.1.n: だ is the casual form of です, used after a noun.

0.2.n: よ at the end draws the listener’s attention to the announcement.

1.0.n: ごはん can mean cooked rice or a meal; here it refers to dinner.

1.1.n: だ is the casual form of です, used after a noun.

1.2.n: よ at the end draws the listener’s attention to the announcement.

2.0.n: This polite form of いただく, meaning to humbly receive, is a set phrase said before eating.

0.tip: ごはんだよ announces mealtime; ready is understood from the situation, not stated directly.

1.tip: ごはんだよ announces mealtime; ready is understood from the situation, not stated directly.

2.tip: Say いただきます before starting a meal, not after finishing it.
